strategies.description: This strategy captures intermediate-term trend continuation by entering when a faster moving average crosses above a slower one. It is designed to participate in sustained upside moves while using a defined stop to limit downside during AMZN's historically deep drawdowns.
strategies.entry_rule: Enter long when the 20-day SMA crosses above the 100-day SMA and the closing price is above both moving averages.
strategies.exit_rule: Exit when the 20-day SMA crosses below the 100-day SMA or when price falls 8% below the entry price, whichever occurs first.
